name: The Gray Guild
description: An underground network of psions, half-trained mages, and collectors of forbidden knowledge, scattered across the Amaranthine. They are not mages of the great colleges—they are hedge-witches, stone-listeners, and those who have heard the Hollow whisper back. They meet in root cellars and the back rooms of libraries, sharing secrets that could be their death if spoken aloud.
location: Thepyrgos, Pereshi highlands, Silkstrand, and Ashaan
leverage: Access to the Celestial Ledger, forbidden scrolls, psionic training, and a network of safe houses in major cities.
debtTrigger: When Obligation fills, the Guild demands a 'lesson'—a teaching from you on a subject they have not yet mastered. If you cannot teach, you may be the lesson.
quirk: Each member wears a hood or mask of gray linen, and they never refer to each other by name. The masks have no eye-holes; they are sewn shut, but they still see perfectly.
keyNPCs: The Teacher (an old woman who has read every book and who hums a tune that silences wards)
The Test (a young man who never sleeps and who always asks the same question: 'What have you seen?')
The Keeper (a mute scholar who writes the Guild's records on a bell that only rings for truth)
hooks: A member has been arrested by the Inquisition of Everflame. The Guild needs someone to rescue them—or silence them.
A Psion has surfaced in Silkstrand with a fragment of a prophecy that could predict the Hollow's next walk. The Guild wants to verify it.
The Guild's current meeting place has been compromised; they need a new safehouse, and the only one available is in a warded Aeler hold.
